note: Bank Al-Maghrib, in a 2021 contract model of its own observatory (read 2026-10-30), asks for a bank account as a 'RIB sur 24 chiffres' (an IBAN only for firms not established in Morocco): the RIB is 24 digits. How the 24 split (the bank's code, the locality, the account and the key) and the key's algorithm weren't read from Bank Al-Maghrib or the bankers' association, so the number is held as one part of 24 digits, with no bank code placed and no check.
